description: This PHP class 'UserAuthProvider' models the authentication provider for a user within the OrangeHRM system, including properties for provider type, LDAP details, and associated user, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: UserAuthProvider
classes.description: Represents a user's authentication provider with properties for provider type, LDAP details, and associated user, mapped to the 'ohrm_user_auth_provider' database table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the UserAuthProvider instance.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the UserAuthProvider instance.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a User entity with this authentication provider.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Gets the type of authentication provider (local or LDAP).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of authentication provider.

methods.name: getLDAPUserHash
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user hash, if any.

methods.name: getLDAPUserDN
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user distinguished name.

methods.name: setLDAPUserDN
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user distinguished name.

methods.name: getLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the LDAP user unique ID.

methods.name: setLDAPUserUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the LDAP user unique ID.
